Slightly off topic: these were guys in my dorm building, not my actual roommates.

Our university dorm building was originally meant for women, but somehow it ended up going to men. So the bathrooms had no urinals: just three squat toilets, separated by partitions.

BUT!

There was a 5 cm gap between the bottom of the partitions and the floor! Supposedly for ventilation, so nobody would be gassed to death by their own fumes.

BUT!

Liquid that splashes onto the floor defies gravity and bounces back... So whenever the guy next door got careless while draining the tank, waves of warmth would come washing over your feet... And in fact, most of the guys in our building had lousy aim...

If you were both just peeing, you could retaliate in a fit of rage, but the real fun came when you were there for the big business. When the next stall door slammed shut, all you could do was pray your neighbor was there for the big business too. Otherwise, let the storm rage over my feet as it will, but please, spare my butt!!
